hwuy: He said: “The daughter of Hwuy Yen cared not to become my bride and has sought her happiness with another.
“See how worthless a thing she is,” said Hwuy Yen to the young bridegroom.

But he was so newly wedded that it was not until Hwuy Yen advanced to the bride and shook his hand threateningly in her face, that he felt himself a husband, and interfered by placing himself before the girl.
